errors.text_span: Графиката е линейна и показва динамиката на шест категории:
errors.evidence: The chart shows seven categories (lines), not six. The description misses one.
The description invents the category "Сиво гориво" (Grey fuel) and incorrectly groups two distinct categories, "Crude oil" and "Natural gas", under this hallucinated name.
The line for "Renewable energy" is light blue/cyan, not light green ("светлозелена").
The line for "Renewable energy" does not show continuous growth; it has visible fluctuations, including a noticeable dip in 2011.
The line for "Renewable energy" ends at an index value of 150 in 2018, not 145.

errors.text_span: достига връх около 120 през 2011 г., след което спада до около 110 през 2014 г. и се стабилизира около 115 до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the "Other" line is completely incorrect. The peak is in 2010 (around 122), not 2011. The line does not stabilize around 115; it increases significantly to a final value of approximately 145 in 2018.

errors.text_span: има леко възходящ тренд до 2010 г. (около 102), след което постепенно спада до около 95 през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The "Total production" line does not have an upward trend until 2010; it stays at or just below 100. The final value in 2018 is approximately 91, not 95.

errors.text_span: спада до около 90 през 2010 г., след което се стабилизира около 90–92 до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the "Nuclear energy" trend is incorrect. It does not drop to 90 in 2010 and does not stabilize at 90-92. It fluctuates and ends at approximately 86 in 2018.

errors.text_span: спада до около 85 през 2010 г., се стабилизира около 85–88 до 2014 г., след което постепенно спада до около 75 през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the "Solid fossil fuels" trend is incorrect. In 2010, the value is around 91, not 85. It does not stabilize but generally declines. The final value in 2018 is approximately 72, not 75.
The line for "Crude oil" (described as "Сиво гориво") is at an index of approximately 90 in 2010, not 80.
The line for "Natural gas" is at an index of approximately 100 in 2010, not 85.

errors.text_span: Графиката не включва легенда, но етикетите са посочени в текстовия ключ в горния десен ъгъл.
errors.evidence: This statement is contradictory. It claims there is no legend, but the "text key" it refers to is, in fact, the legend. This phrasing is confusing.
